title: Update Your Manufacturer Profile | HeatEx Direct

meta.description: Update a Chinese heat exchanger manufacturer profile on HeatEx Direct by emailing company information, product details, files, certificates, images, and correction requests.
meta.keywords: update manufacturer profile, HeatEx Direct supplier profile, Chinese heat exchanger manufacturer update, supplier images, product files

og.title: Update Your Manufacturer Profile - HeatEx Direct
og.description: Send updated manufacturer information, product details, images, files, and corrections to HeatEx Direct by email for review.

hero.title: Update and improve your manufacturer profile.
hero.description: If your company page needs new content, corrected information, updated product details, better images, certificates, brochures, or additional media files, send the materials to our team by email. We review the request and update the public profile where the information is relevant and verifiable.

panel.title: Send the materials first. We will review the page before publishing.

items.title: Download the profile update template first
items.description: Use the template to organize company information, product scope, documents, and image notes. After filling it in, send it by email together with images, certificates, brochures, or download links.

items.title: Provide images as email attachments only
items.description: Send product images, factory photos, workshop images, certificates, brochures, and logos as email attachments only.

items.title: Keep everything in one email thread
items.description: Use a clear subject line with your company name so our team can connect files, corrections, and follow-up questions to the right profile.

update_scope.title: Any profile content that helps buyers understand your company can be reviewed
update_scope.description: The goal is not to publish promotional statements without context. We prefer specific information that improves buyer understanding, technical comparison, and profile accuracy.

items.title: Company information
items.description: Company name, location, website, year founded, business scope, export markets, core industries, and contact details.

items.title: Product capabilities
items.description: Heat exchanger types, applications, materials, pressure and temperature ranges, product series, design standards, and available models.

items.title: Documents and certificates
items.description: Brochures, catalogs, datasheets, certificates, manuals, public-source references, and product files that can support the page.

items.title: Images and media
items.description: Product photos, workshop photos, factory exterior, process images, logos, exhibition images, and other media suitable for public display.

template.title: Downloadable update document
template.description: Manufacturers can download the standard profile update template and fill in company, product, document, and image details in one format. Send the completed file with related images, certificates, brochures, or download links.

process.title: We review updates before changing the public page
process.description: Every update request is handled manually. We may edit language, ask for clarification, or decline content that is incomplete, unverifiable, unrelated, or too promotional.

steps.title: Send materials by email
steps.description: Include the profile link if available, your company name, the fields to update, and any files or image links.

steps.title: We check and organize the content
steps.description: Our team reviews whether the information belongs on the profile, whether files are usable, and whether the wording needs editing.

steps.title: Approved updates go live
steps.description: Relevant updates are added to the manufacturer profile, product pages, or file/media areas after review.

submission.title: How to send your update

contact.subject_description: Use a clear subject line with your company name so our team can connect files to the right profile.

required.title: Completed Template
required.description: Please send the completed profile update template document as an email attachment.

media.title: Image Attachments
media.description: Send product images, factory photos, certificates, and logos as email attachments only.

submission.footer_note: Note: Submitted materials will be manually reviewed before the profile is updated.
